title: कनाडा निवासी NRI को फेक आईडी से फंसाया, 50 हजार डॉलर की मांग, गाजियाबाद पुलिस का सेक्सटॉर्शन गैंग पर बड़ा एक्शन

reading.body:
This is an impersonation and extortion scheme in which generative AI was used to manufacture compromising material, not a case of a model failing on its own. The gang created a fake Facebook profile to approach the victim, recorded him during a video call, and then used AI-generated obscene videos as additional leverage alongside the real recording. The AI output here was a tool for coercion, produced deliberately and aimed at a specific person, which places it outside any legitimate deployment context.

The failure sits at the point of contact between a synthetic identity and a real user. A fabricated profile carried the initial approach, and the AI videos supplied the threat material once contact had been made. Nothing in the reporting describes a platform detecting or blocking the fake account or the generated videos before the extortion demand was made. Catching this kind of operation depends on linking a fraudulent profile to a pattern of complaints, which in this case only happened after the victim came forward and a phone number was traced to dozens of prior fraud reports.

What is not established is the outcome of the case. The four arrests followed an FIR under the BNS and IT Act, and the allegations have not been tested in court. The claim that the gang used AI videos is a police account, and the specific tools or models used to generate them are not identified in the reporting.

reports.title: Jamia Millia student among 4 held for using AI deepfakes to extort money from NRI
4 arrested for ₹6.5 crore extortion racket in Ghaziabad
कनाडा निवासी NRI को फेक आईडी से फंसाया, 50 हजार डॉलर की मांग, गाजियाबाद पुलिस का सेक्सटॉर्शन गैंग पर बड़ा एक्शन

summary:
A Jamia Millia Islamia student and three associates were arrested in Ghaziabad for allegedly extorting a Canada-based NRI using AI-generated explicit videos. Police said Md Faisal, 22, a second-year BCom student, and Md Amaan Tyagi, Md Hammad Tyagi and Md Faizaan Malik created a fake Facebook profile, recorded the victim during a video call on Sept 10, then demanded $50,000 and threatened to upload the footage and AI-made obscene videos. The victim contacted the cybercrime team on Sept 17, and the accused's mobile number was linked to 40 cyber fraud complaints.

Police registered an FIR under the BNS and IT Act and arrested four gang members on Friday, while some associates remain absconding. Investigators said the gang had been active since 2023, used mule accounts and AI videos to target victims in India and abroad, and split proceeds among members. Their phones revealed links to at least 130 bank accounts holding Rs 6.6 crore, and AI sextortion videos were found on their devices.
